estimate.help: Points are relative size, not days. Each story has two estimates. Find a site or meter is the 2 for both.

dev.help: Dev points size the work to build it. Complexity is how hard the logic is. Effort is how much there is to build. Risk is how likely it is to go wrong. Dependencies are what it needs from other teams or stories.

test.help: Test points size the work to check it. Scenarios are how many cases to run. Setup is the data and roles each case needs. Risk is how bad a missed bug would be. Regression is how much else needs a check again.
